Request details
Cthulhu Mythos TRPG "What happened in Bespoke Land?" Illustration of explorer

Brief information about the explorer
HO1 Lucian Granville
29 years old, 180 cm, English tailor.
He is very flexible and joking. His motto is "Noblesse oblige".

HO2 Ric Zelati
26 years old, 170cm, Italian tailor
He is a serious man who is strict with himself and others, and is very talkative and lively.

HO3 Cherish Cherry
24 years old, 150cm, American tailor
An adult male who is energetic, cocky, and does the little shitty moves. He thinks he and what he produces are No. 1.

HO2 and HO3 argue with each other, and HO1 tames them (but only smiles).

Please feel free to add or simplify the costumes as you like. Sorry for the succession of requests.
The composition and situation is up to you!
